rule_title: TTP 1560.001 - Data Staging and Archive via PowerShell Compress-Archive or Archive Utilities
description: Detects creation of archive files via PowerShell Compress-Archive, 7-Zip, WinRAR, or tar, where the source or destination path sits in a commonly abused staging location (C:\Users\Public, C:\ProgramData, C:\Windows\Temp, C:\Temp, AppData\Local\Temp). Attackers stage collected data into an archive before exfiltration. Generic archive use is legitimate; the staging-path combination raises fidelity. Requires Security EID 4688 with command line auditing enabled, or Sysmon EID 1, or PowerShell EID 4104.
